prompt: The image is rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, capturing the bustling energy of a school science fair. In the center stands a tall volcano model erupting with gray foam, positioned next to a small glass beaker filled with blue liquid. To the left of the volcano, a boy in a striped shirt leans forward eagerly, his hand pointing at the bubbling mixture while a girl in a yellow dress looks at the eruption with wide eyes. Behind them, a teacher in a tweed jacket sits on a folding chair, holding a clipboard and looking at a student in a green apron who is handing her a data sheet. On the right side of the scene, a robot with shiny metal arms stands on a wooden table, its claw gripping a red apple. A cat with orange fur sleeps peacefully on the floor beneath the table, curled up next to a black backpack. Near the robot, a man in a blue suit points at the mechanical arm, while a woman in a floral blouse looks at the device with curiosity. In the background, a poster board with colorful charts hangs on the wall, partially obscured by a potted fern in a terracotta pot. A boy in a baseball cap stands near the fern, eating a sandwich, while a girl with pigtails holds a magnifying glass up to a leaf. A brown dog sits calmly beside the girl with pigtails, watching the crowd. A stack of textbooks lies on the floor near the dog, topped with a pair of eyeglasses. A balloon tied to a string floats above the crowd, drifting near the ceiling lights. A janitor in gray overalls sweeps the floor in the far corner, pushing a broom next to a trash can. The scene is lively yet orderly, with each element distinct in the soft washes of color. There is no digital screen visible in the display area. There is no fire or open flame used in the experiments. There is no rain or outdoor weather element present in the indoor setting.
